description.to:
Milestone of epic PPY-6a6357 (initiative PPY-25ffa3). Critical-path plan: PPY-e38a2d. Design note: docs/plans/multi-tenant-architecture.md (PR #1305).

Entry criteria: M2.
Exit criteria: Staging shared stack created in shared tenancy mode (PPY-daf673) after R3, in its own AWS account; PPY-98eaee, PPY-203ce2, PPY-baa75d, PPY-e01d82 released; adversarial suite PPY-29f730 (generator PPY-65e5a9) blocking; group rules removed on the shared stack (PPY-bdc4ee) and tenantId required (PPY-b99fc0); suite green twice in a row; security gate 1 (PPY-3ff465) signed off by Ryan; release gate PPY-f7ce77 on.
Customer-visible: Nothing external.
Index-adding deploys in this milestone: None (the shared stack is a first create: every table is created with all its indexes).
Contains: PPY-daf673, PPY-98eaee, PPY-203ce2, PPY-baa75d, PPY-e01d82, PPY-29f730, PPY-65e5a9, PPY-bdc4ee, PPY-b99fc0, PPY-3ff465, PPY-f7ce77
Follows: M2.

Acceptance (Gherkin):
Scenario: The shared stack starts empty and serves no site (features_backend/shared-stack-bootstrap.feature, PPY-daf673)
Scenario: A Cognito group alone grants nothing on the shared stack (features_backend/tenant-rules-enforced.feature, PPY-bdc4ee)
Scenario: The adversarial suite passes with group rules removed (same file)
Scenario: A model with no isolation case fails the build (features_backend/tenant-isolation-adversarial.feature, PPY-29f730)
Scenario: An editor cannot write another tenant's object (features_backend/tenant-storage-isolation.feature, PPY-98eaee)
Scenario: A monitor delivery lands only in its tenant (features_backend/tenant-worker-scope.feature, PPY-203ce2)
Scenario: A guest cannot list published rows on the shared stack (features_backend/shared-stack-no-guest-api.feature, PPY-baa75d)
Scenario: The workspace shows a new Reference without a subscription (features/topic-steering-refresh-without-subscriptions.feature, PPY-e01d82)
Scenario: A write without a tenant fails on the shared stack (features_backend/tenant-field-required.feature, PPY-b99fc0)
Scenario: A failing isolation case blocks the release (features_backend/shared-release-gate.feature, PPY-f7ce77)
Scenario: Isolation is not claimed before the review (PPY-3ff465)

Acceptance checks:
1. Adversarial suite run against staging twice, zero cross-tenant reads or writes, report attached; every model, index, custom operation, storage path, search index, snapshot file and the edge has a case.
2. Gate 1 sign-off from Ryan recorded on PPY-3ff465 with the threat model link.
3. Dedicated sites unchanged (group rules still generated in dedicated mode).
